evals.prompt: Optimize a slow SQL query causing high latency on the order history API endpoint, measuring baseline and post-index performance.
evals.expected_output: The agent records baseline latency using EXPLAIN ANALYZE, adds a composite database index, and measures post-optimization performance to prove empirical latency improvement.
expectations: Baseline performance metric recorded before any schema/code edit
EXPLAIN ANALYZE query plan evaluated to identify Sequential Scans
Post-optimization benchmark metrics recorded showing empirical improvement

evals.prompt: Run a k6 load test against a web API and optimize bundle size and caching headers for frontend assets.
evals.expected_output: The agent executes k6 load test script, analyzes Web Vitals and bundle size, applies code splitting, and verifies latency reduction.
expectations: Load test executed with k6 measuring P95/P99 latency thresholds
Frontend bundle size optimization and Cache-Control headers applied
Comparative metrics provided demonstrating before-and-after improvement
